A1.policy: class-balanced source-tempered sampling with replacement; reliability in sampling once; unweighted CE

selection: Mean of three fold macro-F1 means over seeds; worst-source agreement as tie-break; never select using V9/V10
finalRefitEpochs: rounded median best epoch of the nine CV runs for the winner; no V8 selection
limitations: Same fighter across source IDs remains unknown.
Fold sizes differ; report source-level and pooled metrics separately.
Adam and heavybag remain training sources in every fold.
All labels remain unverified; these are development folds, not release tests.
CV epoch selection and variant comparison use the same development folds; estimates are selection-biased.
A1 uses capped partial source balancing, not equal sources; tiny video samples remain limited.
Calibration policy uses one previously observed V5 video; no independent precision guarantee.

selected.epochMeaning: fixed refit duration from CV median, not a V8-selected checkpoint
